IdeaModule.intro: Start from a ready template or fill in from scratch — you can add multiple entries to each box.

problem: Small sellers can't open an online store
solution: Set up a store without writing code
A unified workflow in one panel

problem: Users can't keep track of a habit

ResearchModule.intro: Add a competitor or alternative — AI will use the context from your Idea Validation module to suggest and analyze.

RequirementsModule.intro: Add features for your project, then let AI write a user story for each one. You can adjust the priority (MoSCoW) yourself.
RequirementsModule.addPlaceholder: Type a feature name (e.g. Checkout, Login, Product)...

MvpScopeModule.intro: Features from the Requirements module were automatically moved onto this drag-and-drop board. Drag cards to reorganize, or ask AI for a recommendation.
MvpScopeModule.empty: No cards yet — add features and generate user stories in the Requirements module and they'll show up here automatically.

DesignModule.intro: Import your real page/screen structure from a Figma file, or add it by hand. AI reads your actual screens and derives the database schema, API list, and architecture from that real structure — instead of inventing one from nothing.
DesignModule.figmaHelp: Paste your Figma file link and a personal access token (in your Figma account: Settings → Personal access tokens). The token is never stored anywhere — it's only used for this one import request.
DesignModule.importError: Could not import the Figma file.
DesignModule.addPagePlaceholder: Type a page/screen name (e.g. Login Screen)...
DesignModule.generate: Generate schema, API & architecture with AI

TechStackModule.intro: Pick a technology from each category, or ask AI for a recommendation based on your project. The AI has no access to live statistics — it gives a qualitative assessment based on its general knowledge, and never hides that.

ApiDesignModule.intro: If the Design module has pages, its endpoint list was already moved here automatically. Type what you need and let AI generate REST endpoints — then export it as swagger.yaml.

FolderStructureModule.intro: Built from your real choices in Tech Stack, Design, and API Designer — not a generic template, a folder structure specific to your stack and entities.

TaskPlanModule.intro: Splits your project into sprints based on the real context from Idea Validation and MVP scope. Drag cards between sprints, check them off as you complete them.

EnvironmentModule.intro: Based on your real stack from the Tech Stack module — generates a real .gitignore, README, docker-compose.yml, and .env.example tailored to those exact languages.

PromptEngineeringModule.intro: Define rules for your project — AI combines them with your real tech stack and entities to produce actual instruction files for Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI coding assistants.

AiResourcesModule.intro: Pick your project type and let AI recommend real, well-known tools across different categories (coding, design, image generation, backend, etc.). The AI has no access to brand-new tools — it only recommends from its established general knowledge.
AiResourcesModule.customTypePlaceholder: Or type your own project type...

About.heading: We shorten the road from idea to code.
About.intro: DevPlan exists so that anyone holding an idea — a first-time founder or an experienced team — can turn it into a real technical plan. Across 12 modules we work through every decision together, from market research to architecture, from design to sprint planning, until what's left in your hands isn't scattered notes but a project that's ready to be coded.

validate.title: Validate the idea
validate.body: We nail down the problem and the customer first, then let AI draft a real pitch.

research.title: Research the market
research.body: Add competitors and let AI analyze them for you — validate real demand with data, not assumptions.

architect.title: Build the architecture
architect.body: Plan the technology, API, and folder structure that fits your MVP scope, module by module.

ship.title: Ship the code
ship.body: Once you finish all 12 modules, DevPlan Studio is waiting — your plan turns directly into code.

About.mayaBody: Maya is the AI assistant that moves through every module with you. She remembers what you entered in earlier modules and suggests the next step accordingly — the market research module automatically takes into account the customer you defined in idea validation.

MayaIntro.heading: Hi {name}, I'm Maya.
MayaIntro.intro: I'm with you through all 12 modules. At every step I remember what you wrote in earlier modules, so you don't have to explain the same thing twice — however you validated your idea, I carry that context into market research, competitive analysis, and architecture.

guides.title: I point you to what's next
guides.body: When you finish a module, I tell you what's next and why it matters — no need to go back to the dashboard and hunt for it.

generates.title: I draft things for you
generates.body: From pitch copy to competitor analysis, I put together a first draft from what you've entered — you edit and approve.

explains.title: I explain my choices
explains.body: I always explain why I suggested a given technology, endpoint, or sprint order.

MayaIntro.ctaHeading: Pick up where you left off
MayaIntro.ctaBody: There are modules waiting for you on your dashboard.

hero.kicker: FROM IDEA TO CODE, IN 12 MODULES
hero.heading: Turn your idea into a project that's ready to be coded.
hero.sub: DevPlan walks you through market research, architecture, design, and sprint planning alongside your AI assistant, Maya. By the time you finish the last module, you're ready to write code.

modules.heading: 12 modules, one flow
modules.sub: Each module builds on the last — the customer you defined in idea validation carries into market research's competitor suggestions, all the way to the endpoints in API design.
modules.footnote: Plus 6 more: product requirements, MVP planning, project scaffold, sprint planning, AI stack management, and prompt studio.

maya.heading: Maya moves through it with you
maya.body: Maya is the AI assistant working alongside you in every module. She remembers what you entered earlier, suggests the next step, and drafts a first version for you — instead of starting from a blank page, you edit and approve.
maya.voiceover: "Hi, I'm Maya. Don't know where to start? Then you're in exactly the right place. The 12 modules I offer will help you build your own product from scratch and guide you through the right steps to make real progress. Then, in Maya Studio, we'll scale your product together. What makes us different? Your projects won't be left half-finished anymore — knowing exactly what you're doing, you'll track every step with total confidence."

studio.heading: Finish 12 modules, and the editor is waiting
studio.body: DevPlan Studio turns the APIs you planned, the stack you chose, and the flows you designed into real code. Maya is there too — explaining what she changed and why.
